column1: A university wants to analyze the academic performance of its students using multilevel inheritance with three classes: Person, Student, and GraduateStudent.

The Person class stores the student's name and age. The Student class extends Person and additionally stores the marks obtained in three subjects and calculates the total marks and average. The GraduateStudent class extends Student and additionally stores the research score. It calculates a final score by giving 80% weight to the academic average and 20% weight to the research score.
The student is classified as EXCELLENT if the final score is 85 or above, GOOD if it is 70 or above, AVERAGE if it is 50 or above, and NEEDS IMPROVEMENT otherwise.
The program must display the student's name, total marks, academic average, research score, final score, and performance category.
Display the average and final score to 2 decimal places.
- All marks and scores are integers.
